answer: Attestation weight counts only after a refundable copper bond is locked at a rate-limited mint for a full epoch. Each mint underwrites one bond per window, so clones behind it share that cap and cannot raise aggregate influence. A comet detector flags a burst of first-seen keys whose funding graphs collapse to one mint; those keys sit behind a ripple hold until the bond ages the whole window. A flash farm earns nothing unless the attacker waits and posts a fresh bond from a separate mint, assumed costly. A captured mint can still sponsor a farm until slashing burns the bond on collusion.
